name: benops-rpa
description: Claude Code skills for the BenOps RPA team at Gusto

features: Daily briefing, triage, and sync workflows for BenOps RPA engineers

components.name: analyze
components.description: Review current branch changes for XAML issues, naming conventions, and selector quality — run before any PR

components.name: benops-rpa-setup
components.description: Interactive VDI setup for new BenOps RPA team members — installs tools, plugins, and configures MCPs

components.name: benops-sync
components.description: Syncs the BenOps RPA Hub Notion page with current GitHub PR statuses and Jira ticket statuses

components.name: benops-ticket-investigation
components.description: Structured investigation workflow for BenOps RPA production failures — Orchestrator logs before XAML code

components.name: benops-triage-agent
components.description: First-response triage for a BenOps RPA support ticket — reads Slack thread + Jira, diagnoses Production, posts business-facing update

components.name: followup
components.description: Composes and sends daily status update to Sri/Oscar via Slack — reads Sheets queue, open PRs, and Jira

components.name: morning
components.description: Daily briefing — priority contacts sweep, Slack alerts, active Jira tickets, open PRs, next ticket suggestion

components.name: uipath-test-cases-from-ticket
components.description: Creates UiPath Staging test cases from a Jira ticket — samples Production queue items and launches recreator job
